style: Instrumental background music for a gentle children's learning game, ages 7 to 8. Warm, friendly and unhurried, with a clear hummable melody. Steady tempo and even loudness from the first second to the last: no intro build-up, no breakdown, no big finish, no fade-out, so it can repeat as a loop. No vocals, no spoken words, no sound effects.

music_title.prompt: Bright, welcoming adventure theme for a storybook world of rainbow islands. Ukulele, glockenspiel, pizzicato strings, soft hand percussion and a playful recorder melody. Sunny, hopeful, about 104 bpm, C major.

music_woods.prompt: Cosy enchanted forest tune. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar, wooden marimba, soft clarinet melody, light shaker. Curious and calm, like tiptoeing among friendly talking trees, about 92 bpm, G major.

music_bay.prompt: Dreamy underwater lagoon tune. Harp arpeggios, vibraphone, warm soft synth pad, gentle bubbling plucked bass, a floating flute melody. Weightless and soothing, about 84 bpm, F major.

music_dragon.prompt: Plucky, friendly volcano adventure tune. Bouncy bassoon and tuba, pizzicato strings, hand drums and a brave little trumpet melody. Determined but never scary, about 108 bpm, A minor with a cheerful lift.

music_cloud.prompt: Light, airy castle-in-the-sky tune. Celesta, music box, soft flutes and high gentle strings with a skipping waltz feel. Floating and a little mischievous, about 96 bpm in three-four time, D major.

music_candy.prompt: Sweet, bouncy sweet-shop tune. Toy piano, xylophone, kazoo-like soft synth lead, plucked upright bass and finger snaps. Giggly and light on its feet, about 112 bpm, B flat major.

music_star.prompt: Quiet, wondering night-sky tune. Soft felt piano, glassy bells, warm cello and a slow twinkling arpeggio. Tender and hopeful, a little lonely at first and comforting by the end of each phrase, about 76 bpm, E flat major.

music_main.prompt: Bright, playful prehistoric adventure theme for a cartoon time-travel story with friendly dinosaurs. Bouncy marimba and xylophone, wooden log drums and hand drums, pizzicato strings, a cheeky bassoon and a brave little French horn melody. Jungle-explorer feel, fun and curious, about 106 bpm, F major.

music_hollow.prompt: Gentle, cosy prehistoric jungle tune for a sunny valley full of dinosaur nests and hatching eggs. Soft marimba and kalimba, a wooden flute melody, light shakers and rain stick, playful woodwind trills like little birds, warm low strings. Calm and curious, about 92 bpm, G major.

music_chase.prompt: Comic, bouncy cartoon chase music for two friends running away from a fussy dinosaur. Plucky pizzicato strings, tuba and bassoon stomping on the beat, quick xylophone runs, bongos and a cheeky clarinet melody. Exciting and silly but never scary, about 132 bpm, D minor with a cheeky lift.
music_chase.style: Instrumental background music for a children's game, ages 7 to 8. Lively and exciting but friendly, never scary, with a clear catchy melody. Steady tempo and even loudness from the first second to the last: no intro build-up, no breakdown, no big finish, no fade-out, so it can repeat as a loop. No vocals, no spoken words, no sound effects.

music_meadow.prompt: Bouncy, sunny prehistoric meadow tune with a grumpy-but-lovable plodding bass. Plucked banjo and ukulele, tuba on the beat, wooden block percussion, a whistling flute melody over swaying long grass. Cheerful and a little comical, about 100 bpm in three-four feel, D major.

music_swamp.prompt: Warm, steamy prehistoric swamp tune. Gentle bubbling marimba, slide guitar, soft muted trumpet, frog-like wooden guiro and light hand drums, a lazy, glamorous clarinet melody. Playful and a little mysterious, never gloomy, about 90 bpm, E flat major.

music_peaks.prompt: Breezy, soaring mountain-top tune high above the clouds. Bright pizzicato strings, flutes and piccolo like swooping birds, a chiming bell-like glockenspiel, light snare and a heroic little horn melody. Airy, exciting and cheeky, about 112 bpm, A major.

music_ridge.prompt: Quick, clever, sneaky cartoon tune for a pack of mischievous little raptors on warm red rocks. Tiptoeing pizzicato bass, plucky marimba, cheeky clarinet and oboe runs, rattling shakers and claves. Playful keep-away energy, never scary, about 120 bpm, G minor with a cheeky lift.

music_rex.prompt: Big, bold, friendly prehistoric adventure theme for the land of a huge but soft-hearted T-Rex. Booming taiko and timpani stomps, deep tuba and low brass, bold French horns with a heroic melody, marimba and log drums, a distant volcano rumble feel. Epic and exciting but warm and fun, never scary, about 104 bpm, C minor lifting to C major.
